# Omo

<p align="center">
  <img src="../logo-sweet-pastel.svg" alt="Omo" width="256">
</p>

Omo is a pay-per-use AI workflow marketplace, starting with education. These repositories contain first-party `SKILL.md` workflow contracts: bounded, reviewable recipes that describe what a workflow accepts, does, checks, and returns.

## Two doors

### Run it on Omo

[Run the workflow on omo.space](https://omo.space) for cents per use. Omo handles the provider access, validation, privacy boundary, artifact delivery where needed, updates, and billing.

### Run it yourself

Clone the files, bring your own compatible provider keys and runtime, and wire the workflow into your stack. The repositories are transparent workflow contracts—not a promise that provider access, rendering, storage, or production QA is free.

## First-party skills

The following links use the planned `omo-space` GitHub organization path for later publication:

- [Phonics Worksheet Generator](https://github.com/omo-space/phonics-worksheet-generator) — bounded, print-ready worksheets and answer keys.
- [Phonics Story Edit Studio](https://github.com/omo-space/phonics-story-edit-studio) — reviewed edits to owned PhonicsMaker stories.
- [Phonics Reading Error Coach](https://github.com/omo-space/phonics-reading-error-coach) — cautious, teacher-reviewable decoding notes.
- [Illustrated Decodable Story Maker](https://github.com/omo-space/illustrated-decodable-story-maker) — original illustrated phonics stories.
- [Decodable Sentence Creator](https://github.com/omo-space/decodable-sentence-creator) — phonics-constrained practice sentences.

- [Grapheme to Phoneme Converter](https://github.com/omo-space/grapheme-to-phoneme-converter) — dialect-aware spelling-to-sound analysis.

- [Phonics Word List Generator](https://github.com/omo-space/phonics-list-generator) — bounded word lists for reviewed targets.
- [Phonics Rule Explainer](https://github.com/omo-space/phonics-rule-explainer) — concise pattern explanations and examples.
- [Story Idea Generator](https://github.com/omo-space/story-idea-generator) — original, child-safe story premises.
- [Syllable Splitter and Counter](https://github.com/omo-space/syllable-splitter-and-counter) — dialect-aware syllabification and counts.
